vo_01_hook.text: Your hands are busy saving a life. Why does emergency software require your hands?

vo_02_stat.text: Every year, over 350,000 Americans have a cardiac arrest outside a hospital. Most don't survive.

vo_03_architecture.text: Assembly A.I. provides the ears, but it never makes the medical decision. Every critical step comes from a locked protocol.

vo_04_hybrid.text: Protocol lines play in milliseconds. Questions nobody scripted go to Assembly A.I.'s Voice Agent API, which answers in about a second. And the metronome never stops.

vo_05_close.text: KeepAlive. When seconds count, your hands should save a life, not hold a phone.
